items.source: ~z~Come, my children! Come! Come this way! Gather round!
~z~Come on! Move... move! Come on! Come on!
~z~A sign, a sign! Someone has been brought!
~z~Come on! Move! Move! Move! Move it! Move! Move!
items.target: ~z~Ayo! Gerak! Gerak! Gerak! Jalan! Gerak! Gerak!

items.source: ~z~Someone has been brought! It is a sign!

items.target: ~z~Aku akan menutup markas orang-orang cabul ini!

items.source: ~z~We prostrate our continuing youth and vigor...
items.target: ~z~Kami bersujud demi kelanjutan masa muda dan semangat kami...
~z~Aku membawakan kalian semua anak-anak milenial itu!

items.source: ~z~Bleed him dry! That is our legacy!
items.target: ~z~Isap darahnya sampai kering! Itulah warisan kita!

items.source: ~z~Drink of the blood! ~c~~n~Drink of the blood!
~z~I hear you, child... go and collect.
~z~The greatest good, for the greatest generation!
~z~We shall be free once more! ~c~~n~We shall be free once more!
items.target: ~z~Kita akan bebas lagi! ~c~~n~Kita akan bebas lagi!

items.source: ~z~Someone has been brought! It is a sign!
~z~Come this way, everyone, come here! It is a sign that someone has been brought!
items.target: ~z~Kemari semuanya, kemarilah! Ini pertanda bahwa seseorang telah dibawa!

items.source: ~z~The greatest good, for the greatest generation.
~z~For the greatest generation! ~c~~n~For the greatest generation!
~z~The new boom will not be televised!
items.target: ~z~Kejayaan baru tidak akan ditayangkan di televisi!
~z~Akan kubunuh kalian semua, dasar orang gila!

items.source: ~z~Just a couple more lonely hitchhikers for you to...
items.target: ~z~Hanya sepasang penumpang gelap kesepian lagi untuk kalian...

items.source: ~z~Someone has been brought! It is a sign!
~z~Someone has been brought! It is a sign!
~z~We are too many! You cannot retire us all!
items.target: ~z~Kami terlalu banyak! Kau tidak bisa menyingkirkan kami semua!

items.source: ~z~Eat of the flesh. Drink of the blood.
~z~We will not cede to the young!
items.target: ~z~Kami tidak akan menyerah kepada kaum muda!

items.source: ~z~Stop trying to relive the sixties! It's over!
items.target: ~z~Berhenti mencoba menghidupkan kembali era enam puluhan! Sudah selesai!

items.source: ~z~All you do is take, take, take! Typical baby boomers.
items.target: ~z~Yang kalian lakukan hanya ambil, ambil, ambil! Dasar baby boomer.

items.source: ~z~What have you got? What have you got?
items.target: ~z~Apa yang kau bawa? Apa yang kau bawa?

items.source: ~z~At this altar that has been sent to us.
items.target: ~z~Di altar yang telah dikirimkan kepada kami ini.
~z~Lihat, dia tidak paham apa-apa soal pengorbanan!

items.source: ~z~You're the worst cult I've ever seen!
~z~Hail, fellow, what have you got? What have you got?
items.target: ~z~Salam, kawan, apa yang kau bawa? Apa yang kau bawa?

items.source: ~z~Put some clothes on, you old creeps!
~z~Someone has been brought! The tide is turning. Come this way!
items.target: ~z~Seseorang telah dibawa! Keadaan mulai berbalik. Kemari!

items.source: ~z~He is on the cusp! The boom is weak in him!
items.target: ~z~Dia ada di ambang batas! Kejayaan lemah dalam dirinya!

items.source: ~z~We will boom again! You cannot stop us!
items.target: ~z~Kita akan berjaya kembali! Kau tidak bisa menghentikan kami!

items.source: ~z~We shall boom again! ~c~~n~We shall boom again!
items.target: ~z~Kita akan berjaya kembali! ~c~~n~Kita akan berjaya kembali!

items.source: ~z~Someone has been brought! Someone has been brought!
~z~He's come again! Our friend is back! Our true friend!
items.target: ~z~Dia datang lagi! Teman kita kembali! Teman sejati kita!

items.source: ~z~Well, then it is time to be true to ourselves, my child.
items.target: ~z~Kalau begitu, sudah waktunya untuk jujur pada diri sendiri, anakku.

items.source: ~z~We won't die until the young are old themselves!
items.target: ~z~Kami tidak akan mati sampai kaum muda itu tua sendiri!

items.source: ~z~Our greatest success will be their failure!
items.target: ~z~Kesuksesan terbesar kami akan menjadi kegagalan mereka!

items.source: ~z~Eat of the flesh! Drink of the blood!
~z~And so it is... and so it is... leave the body, take the gold...
~z~I heard you were interested in taking care of some lost travelers... for a price...
items.target: ~z~Kudengar kalian tertarik mengurus beberapa pelancong yang tersesat... dengan bayaran tertentu...
~z~Aku yang menentukan siapa yang boleh meminum darahku!

items.source: ~z~Someone has been brought! It is a sign!
~z~From this point on, every generation shall be poorer than the last!
items.target: ~z~Mulai saat ini, setiap generasi akan lebih miskin dari generasi sebelumnya!

items.source: ~z~rehabilitate or... just give me the money, alright? I really don't give a shit...
items.target: ~z~rehabilitasi atau... beri saja aku uangnya, oke? Aku benar-benar masa bodoh...

items.source: ~z~Eat of the flesh! ~c~~n~Eat of the flesh!
Use explosives to blow open the locked door.
items.target: Gunakan bahan peledak untuk meledakkan pintu yang terkunci.

items.source: ~a~ failed to land on the FIB building rooftop.
items.target: ~a~ gagal mendarat di atap gedung FIB.

items.source: ~a~ failed to deploy the chute in time.
Hold off the ~r~FIB~s~ while the data is downloaded.
Hold ~INPUT_RELOAD~ to glance at the terminal and view the progress of the download.
items.target: Tahan ~INPUT_RELOAD~ untuk melirik terminal dan melihat proses pengunduhan.

items.source: The helicopter is unable to take off.
Press ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RLEFT~ to jump out of the helicopter.
items.target: Tekan ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RLEFT~ untuk melompat keluar dari helikopter.

items.source: Press or hold ~INPUT_VEH_CIN_CAM~ to focus on the landing zone.
items.target: Tekan atau tahan ~INPUT_VEH_CIN_CAM~ untuk fokus pada zona pendaratan.

items.source: Hold ~INPUT_PARACHUTE_BRAKE_LEFT~ and ~INPUT_PARACHUTE_BRAKE_RIGHT~ to slow the descent to land.
items.target: Tahan ~INPUT_PARACHUTE_BRAKE_LEFT~ dan ~INPUT_PARACHUTE_BRAKE_RIGHT~ untuk memperlambat laju pendaratan.

items.source: Hold ~INPUT_PARACHUTE_PRECISION_LANDING~ to slow the descent to land.
Hold ~INPUT_MOVE_DOWN_ONLY~ to rappel.~n~Hold ~INPUT_MOVE_DOWN_ONLY~ + press ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RDOWN~ to jump.~n~Hold ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RLEFT~ to do larger jumps.
items.target: Tahan ~INPUT_MOVE_DOWN_ONLY~ untuk meluncur turun.~n~Tahan ~INPUT_MOVE_DOWN_ONLY~ + tekan ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RDOWN~ untuk melompat.~n~Tahan ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RLEFT~ untuk lompatan lebih jauh.

items.source: Hold ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RDOWN~ to quick rope to the ground.
items.target: Tahan ~INPUT_SCRIPT_RDOWN~ untuk meluncur cepat dengan tali ke tanah.

items.source: The cops discovered the crew at the NOOSE facility.
items.target: Polisi menemukan kru di fasilitas NOOSE.

items.source: ~z~You can break into people's computers, but we can't break into yours?
items.target: ~z~Kalian bisa meretas komputer orang lain, tapi kami tidak boleh meretas komputer kalian?

items.source: ~z~while the last of the baby boomers pretends he's a hacker? Come on, it was hopeful.
items.target: ~z~selagi generasi baby boomer terakhir berpura-pura menjadi peretas? Ayolah, tadinya ada secercah harapan.

items.source: ~z~Enough of this crap, let's get out!
items.target: ~z~Cukup omong kosong ini, ayo kita keluar!

items.source: ~z~N-n-not yet. The final program should get me access to the d-data.
items.target: ~z~B-b-belum. Program terakhir seharusnya memberiku akses ke d-data.

items.source: ~z~Come on in, man, but, don't forget to take your shoes off.
items.target: ~z~Masuklah, kawan, tapi jangan lupa lepas sepatumu.

items.source: ~z~Sprinklers brought the fire under control, but be extremely careful.
items.target: ~z~Pemercik air sudah mengendalikan apinya, tapi tetaplah berhati-hati.

items.source: ~z~Or, how about we meet halfway, and I spend some of the green on women for us - me and you - we could share one, man.
items.target: ~z~Atau bagaimana kalau kita cari jalan tengah, sebagian uangnya kupakai menyewa wanita untuk kita - kita bisa berbagi, kawan.

items.source: ~z~Okay It's doing its thing. If I survive to take another score, I'm bringing someone competent.
items.target: ~z~Oke programnya sedang berjalan. Kalau aku selamat sampai perampokan berikutnya, aku bakal bawa orang yang kompeten.

items.source: ~z~based on some inappropriate decision I made a long time ago.
items.target: ~z~berdasarkan keputusan keliru yang kubuat dulu sekali.

items.source: ~z~Probably a bit of both. No one's gonna clap me,
items.target: ~z~Mungkin dua-duanya. Tidak ada yang bakal berani menghabisiku,

items.source: ~z~Your cell will show as an external device.
~z~Alright, alright, we're clear. Frank, I told Lest we could use your place for a postmortum.
items.target: ~z~Oke, oke, kita aman. Frank, kubilang ke Lest kita bisa pakai tempatmu untuk evaluasi.

items.source: ~z~Hey, we knew this was coming! Let's do this!
items.target: ~z~Hei, kita sudah tahu ini bakal terjadi! Ayo selesaikan!

items.source: ~z~You want me to get out and ice some, give me the word.
items.target: ~z~Kalau kau mau aku keluar dan menghabisi beberapa dari mereka, beri aku aba-aba.
~z~Kita bakal selesai di sini sebentar lagi!

items.source: ~z~Get ready for extraction, airlift is imminent.
items.target: ~z~Bersiaplah untuk evakuasi, penjemputan udara segera tiba.

items.source: ~z~Looks like security is right on top of you.
items.target: ~z~Sepertinya petugas keamanan tepat di atas kalian.
~z~A-apa yang kau butuhkan ada di My Computer.

items.source: ~z~Check the right side of the roof!
~z~You're not going to make it from here, keep going.
items.target: ~z~Kau tidak akan sampai dari sini, teruslah naik.
~z~Rencana yang terorganisir dengan sangat rapi, kawan-kawan!

items.source: ~z~Run the BruteForce app. It should get you through the firewall.
items.target: ~z~Jalankan aplikasi BruteForce. Itu bakal menembus firewall.

items.source: ~z~You're not exactly filling me with confidence, team leader.
items.target: ~z~Kau tidak membuatku merasa yakin sama sekali, pemimpin tim.

items.source: ~z~I'd gladly give up my take for the experience of working with you, Mr. Townley. But, you know, a deal's a deal.
items.target: ~z~Dengan senang hati kurelakan bagianku demi pengalaman bekerja dengan Anda, Tn. Townley. Tapi kesepakatan tetaplah kesepakatan.

items.source: ~z~or whatever else blowback there might be.
items.target: ~z~atau dampak buruk apa pun yang mungkin timbul.

items.source: ~z~Cut-rate asshole - if it's any longer than that, we're gonna have words.
items.target: ~z~Bajingan murahan - kalau lebih lama dari itu, kita bakal bikin perhitungan.

items.source: ~z~To the right, man. Look, about every flashing light in the city.
items.target: ~z~Di sebelah kanan, kawan. Lihat, hampir semua lampu sirine polisi di kota ini ada di sana.

items.source: ~z~There'll be more scores down the road, maybe a big one and sunnier days ahead.
items.target: ~z~Masih bakal ada perampokan lain di masa depan, mungkin yang besar, dan masa depan yang lebih cerah.

items.source: ~z~Agent Haines said the timings were tight.
~z~I just wanted some sympathy, alright? I didn't mean anything by it. Nothing at all.
items.target: ~z~Aku cuma butuh sedikit simpati, oke? Aku tidak bermaksud apa-apa. Sama sekali tidak.

items.source: ~z~Looks like the only place I'll be retiring is a maximum security facility.
items.target: ~z~Sepertinya satu-satunya tempat pensiunku nanti adalah penjara berkeamanan maksimum.

items.source: ~z~Man, can the hacker shut it off?
~z~At a girl. Whatever we're paying you - you're worth it.
items.target: ~z~Pintar. Berapa pun kami membayarmu - kau pantas mendapatkannya.

items.source: ~z~Why don't you see what the other program does?
items.target: ~z~Kenapa kau tidak lihat apa fungsi program yang lainnya?

items.source: ~z~You don't wanna follow us too close!
items.target: ~z~Kalian tidak mau mengikuti kami terlalu dekat!

items.source: ~z~What am I supposed to be doing!?
~z~We got to take out that chopper!
~z~Eh, at least I'm getting paid for this job.
items.target: ~z~Yah, setidaknya aku dibayar untuk pekerjaan ini.

items.source: ~z~I did everything I could to make this easy - but now it's going to be difficult!
items.target: ~z~Aku sudah lakukan segalanya agar ini mudah - tapi sekarang ini bakal jadi sulit!

items.source: ~z~Hold on! I hear something in the stairwell.
~z~Dude, that chopper crash ripped the ass out the building.
items.target: ~z~Bung, tabrakan helikopter itu meremukkan bagian samping gedung.
~z~Pria Irlandia ini tidak bakal mati konyol di sini!

items.source: ~z~All we got to be is smarter than all the cops in the city combined - it ain't a big ask.
items.target: ~z~Kita cuma harus lebih pintar dari gabungan semua polisi di kota ini - bukan permintaan yang muluk-muluk.

items.source: ~z~This is like, way way above my skill level.
~z~Hey we got a problem up here - sprinkler system - can't see anything.
items.target: ~z~Hei kita ada masalah di atas sini - sistem pemercik air menyala - tidak kelihatan apa-apa.

items.source: ~z~The cops are going to spot us! They're gonna spot us!
items.target: ~z~Polisi bakal memergoki kita! Mereka bakal melihat kita!

items.source: ~z~We were prepared for this! Let's take 'em!
items.target: ~z~Kita sudah siap untuk ini! Ayo habisi mereka!

items.source: ~z~This is not good, where's our getaway?
items.target: ~z~Ini gawat, di mana kendaraan pelarian kita?

items.source: ~z~Awesome, we made it there in the end.
~z~That's it. You're done. G-get the device.
~z~They're just cops - they aren't that smart.
items.target: ~z~Mereka cuma polisi biasa - tidak sepintar itu.
~z~Omong kosong! Mereka sudah tahu! Ayo bergerak!

items.source: ~z~When I got the call that you needed backup, I didn't need to take it.
items.target: ~z~Waktu ditelepon bahwa kau butuh bantuan cadangan, sebenarnya aku tidak harus menerimanya.

items.source: ~z~More guys on the right side of the roof!
items.target: ~z~Ada musuh lagi di sisi kanan atap!

items.source: ~z~I need every penny I can get...
items.target: ~z~Aku butuh setiap sen yang bisa kudapatkan...

items.source: ~z~Hold it together, man. We'll do this!
~z~I'm lucky I can even breathe at this altitude.
items.target: ~z~Masih untung aku bisa bernapas di ketinggian begini.

items.source: ~z~Hey, that was a good call on the ambulance, Eddie.
items.target: ~z~Hei, ide bagus membawa ambulans itu, Eddie.

items.source: ~z~The place is up here. Chopper pilot, gunman, driver and hacker should be waiting. I'll radio in.
items.target: ~z~Lokasinya di atas sini. Pilot helikopter, penembak, sopir, dan peretas seharusnya sudah menunggu. Aku akan menghubungi lewat radio.
~z~Kita sudah dapat apa yang kita cari.

items.source: ~z~Start the Down & Out app and l-let it run.
items.target: ~z~Buka aplikasi Down & Out dan b-biarkan berjalan.

items.source: ~z~I didn't think the FIB had shit like that!
items.target: ~z~Aku tidak menyangka FIB punya persenjataan seperti itu!

items.source: ~z~I don't know what they got on you dudes, but that's some heavy shit to get into for free.
items.target: ~z~Aku tidak tahu apa yang mereka pegang dari kalian, tapi urusan berat begini gila kalau dikerjakan gratis.

items.source: ~z~I'm just here to help man, he's dying. Help me, let's go!
items.target: ~z~Aku cuma di sini untuk menolong, dia sekarat. Bantu aku, ayo jalan!

items.source: ~z~Yeah, no shit, man. Cops have the whole block locked down. It's going to be another few minutes!
items.target: ~z~Ya, sudah jelas, kawan. Polisi memblokade seluruh area ini. Masih butuh beberapa menit lagi!

items.source: ~z~Unidentified rotorcraft sighted in vicinity of red zone.
items.target: ~z~Helikopter tak dikenal terlihat di sekitar zona merah.

items.source: ~z~But this is where we are right now. So let's try to survive it, and achieve our objectives.
items.target: ~z~Tapi inilah situasi kita saat ini. Jadi ayo kita berusaha bertahan hidup dan capai tujuan kita.

items.source: ~z~Hey! This could be our way out!
items.target: ~z~Hei! Ini bisa jadi jalan keluar kita!

items.source: ~z~I see you spending this money in a way that the authorities will notice,
items.target: ~z~Kalau sampai kulihat kau menghamburkan uang ini sampai aparat curiga,

items.source: ~z~And then I'd, like, run the connector.
items.target: ~z~Lalu aku bakal, semacam, menjalankan program penghubungnya.

items.source: ~z~Eddie, the place is up here. Can you ditch the vehicle, and drop this guy where he wants to go?
items.target: ~z~Eddie, lokasinya di atas sini. Bisakah kau singkirkan kendaraannya, lalu antar orang ini ke tempat tujuannya?

items.source: ~z~Uhh... yeah, thanks. I'll take a rain check on that little party.
items.target: ~z~Uhh... ya, terima kasih. Aku tunda dulu pesta kecil itu.

items.source: ~z~Unless you feeling at home in the Fed building.
items.target: ~z~Kecuali kalau kau merasa betah di gedung Federal ini.
~z~Di atas sana, tepat di depan - musuh!

items.source: ~z~And if they don't, he got a homeboy named Trevor that probably will.
items.target: ~z~Dan kalau mereka tidak membunuhmu, dia punya sohib bernama Trevor yang kemungkinan besar bakal melakukannya.

items.source: ~z~Man, ain't we got a highly defended Federal building to fucking rob?
items.target: ~z~Kawan, bukankah kita harus merampok gedung Federal berkeamanan ketat ini?

items.source: ~z~Hey! You're good to go, man. Grab it.
~z~All I done wrong is taken a job with these fools, officer!
items.target: ~z~Satu-satunya kesalahanku cuma mengambil pekerjaan bersama orang-orang bodoh ini, pak polisi!

items.source: ~z~Right side of the roof! Look out!
~z~He was only supposed to be a backup. If the chopper hadn't crashed, we wouldn't have needed him.
items.target: ~z~Dia cuma ditugaskan sebagai cadangan. Kalau helikopternya tidak jatuh, kita tidak akan butuh dia.

items.source: ~z~Hey, I was semi sorta serious, but joking once you reacted like that, alright?
items.target: ~z~Hei, tadinya aku agak serius, tapi jadi bercanda begitu melihat reaksimu, oke?

items.source: ~z~Hey, Taliana, right? Great move bringing an ambulance.
items.target: ~z~Hei, Taliana, kan? Langkah hebat membawa ambulans.

items.source: ~z~You got a professional setup here. Chopper's ready to go.
items.target: ~z~Persiapan kalian sangat profesional. Helikopternya siap berangkat.

items.source: ~z~and picks off a letter at a time.
~z~It's done, man. Go grab your cell.
~z~This Fed chopper's ready to take us. Let's get going.
items.target: ~z~Helikopter Federal ini siap mengangkut kita. Ayo berangkat.

items.source: ~z~I don't wanna wait on the chopper, bring it down to the building, be ready to go.
items.target: ~z~Aku tidak mau menunggu helikopternya lama-lama, turunkan ke gedung, siap-siap berangkat.

items.source: ~z~I guess you didn't know this was a stealth operation when you were out parachute shopping.
items.target: ~z~Kurasa kau tidak tahu ini operasi senyap waktu kau belanja parasut itu.

items.source: ~z~To be honest, I must have skipped this class in school.
items.target: ~z~Sejujurnya, aku pasti membolos saat materi ini diajarkan di sekolah.

items.source: ~z~We got out the building. That's the hard part done, you know what I'm saying, so just lose 'em.
items.target: ~z~Kita sudah keluar dari gedung. Bagian tersulitnya sudah lewat, kau paham maksudku kan, jadi hilangkan saja jejak mereka.

items.source: ~z~Yo, check it, the chopper we used ended up in that fountain.
items.target: ~z~Woi, lihat, helikopter yang kita pakai tadi berakhir di kolam air mancur itu.

items.source: ~z~Nah, man, what you need is a damn drink.
items.target: ~z~Bukan, kawan, yang kau butuhkan itu minuman keras.

items.source: ~z~but you and Trevor attacking Merryweather... repeatedly... it doesn't help.
items.target: ~z~tapi kau dan Trevor menyerang Merryweather... berkali-kali... itu tidak membantu sama sekali.

items.source: ~z~Feels okay to me. He might be a better pilot, but I'm less inclined to kill you in your sleep.
items.target: ~z~Rasanya aman-aman saja bagiku. Dia mungkin pilot yang lebih jago, tapi aku tidak punya niat membunuh kalian saat tidur.

items.source: ~z~Let's get the fuck out of here then!
items.target: ~z~Kalau begitu ayo kita cabut dari sini, bangsat!

items.source: ~z~The shots are coming from up top!
~z~Can we just get out of here?
items.target: ~z~Bisa tidak kita keluar dari sini sekarang?

items.source: ~z~So, if I were you, I'd, like, find My Hack Programs.
items.target: ~z~Jadi, kalau aku jadi kau, aku bakal cari My Hack Programs.
~z~Hubungi lewat radio kalau kau butuh aku.

items.source: ~z~It's still too hot for me to go for the files! Let's take care of these guys!
items.target: ~z~Baku tembak masih terlalu sengit bagiku untuk mengambil file! Habisi dulu orang-orang ini!
~z~Biar kutebak - bayaran sopir ini murah kan.

items.source: ~z~Don't try and make me feel bad for accepting a reasonable payment for a hard day's work.
items.target: ~z~Jangan coba-coba membuatku merasa bersalah karena menerima bayaran wajar atas kerja keras sehari penuh.

items.source: ~z~That's the thinking we pay you to do.
~z~At least one of us is a computer expert...
items.target: ~z~Setidaknya salah satu dari kita ahli komputer...

items.source: ~z~And then when the chopper crashed? Man. I thought there was no fucking way.
items.target: ~z~Lalu pas helikopternya jatuh? Gila. Kupikir kita sudah pasti mampus.

items.source: ~z~On it, bro. I'll get over there.
~z~If that chopper hadn't crashed, I wouldn't even need to be here!
items.target: ~z~Kalau helikopternya tidak jatuh, aku bahkan tidak perlu ada di sini!

items.source: ~z~We're meant to be a paramedic crew - that means no shooting - if you're a dick you lose your dick, okay?
items.target: ~z~Kita seharusnya menyamar jadi kru paramedis - artinya jangan menembak - kalau kau cari masalah, kau bakal kehilangan 'burung'mu, paham?

items.source: ~z~Ah, security's almost on top of you.
~z~Up on the roof - down the center, man - more dudes!
items.target: ~z~Di atas atap - bagian tengah, kawan - ada musuh lagi!

items.source: ~z~You're looking for the IP address - that number at the top - in the mass of numbers in the middle.
items.target: ~z~Kau mencari alamat IP - angka yang di bagian atas itu - di antara tumpukan angka di tengah.

items.source: ~z~Uh... uh.  I can try, but the system's in overload after what happened.
items.target: ~z~Uh... uh. Aku bisa coba, tapi sistemnya kelebihan beban setelah kejadian tadi.

items.source: ~z~High speed chase... adrenaline pumping... sirens... smell of smoke...
items.target: ~z~Kejar-kejaran kecepatan tinggi... adrenalin memuncak... sirene meraung... bau asap...

items.source: ~z~I'm gonna shoot you in the face!
~z~If any of you discharge your weapons - the whole illusion that we're an ambulance is gonna be lost.
items.target: ~z~Kalau ada yang menembak - penyamaran kita sebagai ambulans bakal buyar semua.
~z~Apa yang bakal kita lakukan dengan orang ini?

items.source: ~z~Don't use your weapons, they gotta think we're a legit ambulance.
items.target: ~z~Jangan gunakan senjata kalian, mereka harus mengira kita ambulans asli.

items.source: ~z~You guys are gonna make it clear that I didn't do any of that stuff inside the building?
items.target: ~z~Kalian bakal jelaskan kalau aku tidak terlibat apa pun di dalam gedung itu kan?

items.source: ~z~Okay, I'm in. You got anything other than a guess for this part?
items.target: ~z~Oke, aku sudah masuk. Kau punya petunjuk lain selain tebak-tebakan untuk bagian ini?

items.source: ~z~Here's some knowledge for your ass - this program tries lotsa different passwords
items.target: ~z~Ini pelajaran buatmu - program ini mencoba banyak kata sandi berbeda

items.source: ~z~Now lemme school you - your IP is a number, that number at the top,
items.target: ~z~Biar kuajari - IP itu angka, angka yang di bagian atas,

items.source: ~z~The room on the left! They're coming!
~z~I saw what was going on in the Bureau, man. I wasn't going to drive up in something obvious.
items.target: ~z~Aku lihat apa yang terjadi di Biro tadi, kawan. Aku tidak mungkin datang dengan kendaraan yang mencolok.

items.source: ~z~We're meeting Lester at your house, Frank.
~z~When I brought those sports bikes down the tunnel after Vangelico - man,
items.target: ~z~Waktu kubawa motor-motor balap itu melewati terowongan setelah perampokan Vangelico - kawan,

items.source: ~z~Look, man, he was just messing with y'all. It's his great sense of humor. The FIB people who put us up to this,
items.target: ~z~Dengar, kawan, dia cuma bercanda dengan kalian. Selera humornya memang begitu. Orang-orang FIB yang menyuruh kita,

items.source: ~z~So, M. You goin' clear this room, or what?
items.target: ~z~Jadi, M. Kau mau membersihkan ruangan ini, atau bagaimana?

items.source: ~z~This download's taking a hella long time, bros. You gotta chill.
~z~She ain't goin' bite you. Run Brute Force.
items.target: ~z~Komputernya tidak bakal menggigitmu. Jalankan Brute Force.

items.source: ~z~How you got in your situation's none of my concern.
items.target: ~z~Bagaimana kau sampai berada di situasimu bukan urusanku.

items.source: ~z~Do you know how much time we'll get if we're caught right now?
items.target: ~z~Kau tahu berapa lama hukuman kita kalau kita tertangkap sekarang?

items.source: ~z~Dudes in that room on the left!
items.target: ~z~Ada orang di ruangan sebelah kiri itu!

items.source: ~z~Over to the right, dog. Man, there's about every cop in LS County on the way.
items.target: ~z~Di sebelah kanan, kawan. Hampir seluruh polisi di County Los Santos sedang menuju ke sini.

items.source: ~z~Do not discharge your weapons - we want them to think we're a legitimate paramedic crew.
items.target: ~z~Jangan tembakkan senjata kalian - kita ingin mereka mengira kita kru paramedis sungguhan.

items.source: ~z~I should know this, bro! I thought I had it all down!
items.target: ~z~Seharusnya aku tahu ini, kawan! Kupikir aku sudah hafal semuanya di luar kepala!

items.source: ~z~Okay. I need my engineer stationed outside the building, calling in updates.
items.target: ~z~Oke. Aku butuh insinyurku bersiaga di luar gedung, memberi kabar perkembangan.

items.source: ~z~HackConnect's the first program you need - it'll start the connection.
items.target: ~z~HackConnect adalah program pertama yang kau butuhkan - program itu akan memulai koneksi.

items.source: ~z~Nah, no. I'd probably better do this alone.
~z~Take the gun. Man, you really bring that piece to a raid on a Federal building?
items.target: ~z~Ambil pistolnya. Kau serius bawa senjata begitu untuk menyerbu gedung Federal?

items.source: ~z~It's a common trick. If the crew don't get jumpy, it usually works.
items.target: ~z~Trik yang sudah biasa. Asalkan krunya tidak panik, biasanya berhasil.

items.source: ~z~They got mad dudes arriving in un momentito.
~z~If we're caught, I assume you'll do the honorable thing, and take the heat for this.
items.target: ~z~Kalau kita tertangkap, kuharap kau berjiwa kesatria dan menanggung semua kesalahannya.

items.source: ~z~Whoa! Now we're clear, I can probably say, I never expected to make it out of there.
items.target: ~z~Wah! Sekarang setelah kita aman, jujur saja kubilang, aku sama sekali tidak menyangka bisa keluar hidup-hidup dari sana.

items.source: ~z~Up there, left side of the roof!
~z~Jumping out, and climbing in through the Bureau skylight.
items.target: ~z~Terjun keluar, dan menyusup masuk lewat jendela atap Biro.

items.source: ~z~B-be careful, people. Heard some chatter from the air unit. I think they've seen you.
items.target: ~z~H-hati-hati semuanya. Kudengar percakapan dari unit udara. Sepertinya mereka melihat kalian.
~z~Omong kosong! Menurutku kita mulai tembak saja!

items.source: ~z~I'm cool. Are you cool? I'm completely cool.
items.target: ~z~Aku santai. Kau santai? Aku sangat santai.

items.source: ~z~Look out! Guys on the roof - your left!
items.target: ~z~Awas! Ada orang di atap - sebelah kirimu!

items.source: ~z~There's no getting out of this, I'm afraid.
items.target: ~z~Kurasa tidak ada jalan keluar dari ini.

items.source: ~z~Good people bring the right tools for an occasion. Let's get ready for the security team.
items.target: ~z~Orang hebat selalu membawa perlengkapan yang tepat. Mari bersiap menghadapi tim keamanan.

items.source: ~z~They goin' rendition us or some shit, if we get caught.
items.target: ~z~Mereka bakal menculik kita ke penjara rahasia kalau kita tertangkap.

items.source: ~z~Alright, Karim - good work getting the ambulance.
items.target: ~z~Baiklah, Karim - kerja bagus sudah dapat ambulansnya.

items.source: ~z~Yeah, I done did my homework this time - access My Computer.
items.target: ~z~Ya, kali ini aku sudah belajar - buka My Computer.
~z~Kau puas dengan hasil ini, pemimpin tim!?

items.source: ~z~It's expensive, and there ain't much else for me in sunny Los Santos, so... you know, I need that money.
items.target: ~z~Biayanya mahal, dan tidak banyak peluang lain buatku di Los Santos, jadi... kau tahu kan, aku butuh uang itu.

items.source: ~z~The driver's meeting us out front, right?
~z~So what if my cell phone tells the time - having a cell phone ain't the same as wearing twelve grand on your wrist.
items.target: ~z~Memangnya kenapa kalau ponselku ada jamnya - punya ponsel tidak sama dengan memakai jam seharga dua belas ribu dolar di pergelangan tangan.

items.source: ~z~If we are going to do this thing,
~z~Eh, set up the rope there, and we'll drop to the street.
items.target: ~z~Pasang talinya di sana, lalu kita turun ke jalan.

items.source: ~z~The heli crash caused extensive damage. Explosion went through a couple of floors.
items.target: ~z~Tabrakan heli menyebabkan kerusakan parah. Ledakannya menembus beberapa lantai.

items.source: ~z~Alright, I need IT outside the FIB building, ready for the cyber part of this op.
items.target: ~z~Baiklah, aku butuh orang IT di luar gedung FIB, siap untuk bagian peretasan operasi ini.

items.source: ~z~called me out for being an ungrateful prick on the way over here.
items.target: ~z~menyebutku bajingan tak tahu terima kasih dalam perjalanan ke sini.

items.source: ~z~How you doing with the cop problem?
~z~Taliana, we're coming up on the place. Can you do me a favor - get rid of the vehicle, and drop him off somewhere?
items.target: ~z~Taliana, kita hampir sampai. Tolong singkirkan kendaraannya, dan turunkan dia di suatu tempat?

items.source: ~z~Guys on the right side of the rooflight!
items.target: ~z~Ada musuh di sisi kanan jendela atap!

items.source: ~z~The programs are on your cellphone. Connect it to the machine.
items.target: ~z~Programnya ada di ponselmu. Sambungkan ke komputernya.

items.source: ~z~They'll get wise to us if any of you assholes let's off a shot - so don't, alright?
items.target: ~z~Mereka bakal tahu penyamaran kita kalau ada dari kalian yang menembak - jadi jangan lakukan, paham?

items.source: ~z~The terminal, my bad. Connect your cell, apps are on there.
items.target: ~z~Maksudku terminalnya, maaf. Sambungkan ponselmu, aplikasinya ada di situ.

items.source: ~z~Feels weird not having Trevor on the stick.
items.target: ~z~Terasa aneh tanpa Trevor yang memegang kemudi.

items.source: ~z~you're looking for it in the numbers in the middle.
items.target: ~z~kau mencarinya di antara angka-angka di tengah.

items.source: ~z~Alright, alright. Well, take care of yourself.
~z~On the left! Coming out that room there!
items.target: ~z~Di sebelah kiri! Keluar dari ruangan di sana!

items.source: ~z~Great. Now there's something to look forward to...
items.target: ~z~Bagus. Sekarang ada hal yang bisa kita nantikan...

items.source: ~z~I noticed a bug in the jewel store system, might be here too. Did that work?
items.target: ~z~Kulihat ada celah sistem di toko perhiasan tempo hari, mungkin ada di sini juga. Berhasil tidak?

items.source: ~z~When that letter comes up, you gotta get it, a'ight? Real quick.
items.target: ~z~Saat huruf itu muncul, kau harus menguncinya, paham? Cepat sekali.

items.source: ~z~I'm gonna stay here and make sure this download happens!
items.target: ~z~Aku bakal tetap di sini dan pastikan unduhan ini selesai!
~z~Bagaimana cara kita keluar dari situasi ini!?

items.source: ~z~You're the IT guy, right? You don't need me telling you what to do.
items.target: ~z~Kau orang IT-nya kan? Kau tidak perlu kuberi tahu apa yang harus dilakukan.

items.source: ~z~maybe you should give him a call now.
~z~I'm like more of a designer than a network programmer, you dig?
items.target: ~z~Aku ini lebih ke desainer daripada pemrogram jaringan, paham kan?

items.source: ~z~Just want to say what an honor it is working with you, Mr. Townley... De Santa.
items.target: ~z~Cuma ingin bilang, suatu kehormatan bisa bekerja dengan Anda, Tn. Townley... De Santa.

items.source: ~z~Dudes up on the roof - right in front of us, dog!
items.target: ~z~Ada musuh di atap - tepat di depan kita, kawan!

items.source: ~z~Put they necks on the line. Man, where's my get out of jail free card, motherfucker?
items.target: ~z~Mempertaruhkan nyawa mereka. Di mana jaminan bebas penjaraku, bajingan?

items.source: ~z~Like everything else, this is a poorly organised getaway.
items.target: ~z~Sama seperti yang lainnya, pelarian ini direncanakan dengan sangat buruk.

items.source: ~z~The driver's meant to be around front.
~z~It's g-gonna get real nasty in there in a couple of minutes. So... err...
items.target: ~z~S-situasi bakal sangat kacau di sana dalam beberapa menit. Jadi... err...

items.source: ~z~I guess this has all gotta be gone.
~z~You don't wanna get in our way!
~z~Hey, everyone. Quick pep talk. My friend Franklin here,
items.target: ~z~Hei, semuanya. Sedikit arahan singkat. Temanku Franklin di sini,

items.source: ~z~Hey, this is a covert op, you think about that when choosing a chute?
items.target: ~z~Hei, ini operasi rahasia, apa kau memikirkan itu saat memilih parasut?

items.source: ~z~Is this like treason? Are they gonna put us in a hole?
items.target: ~z~Apakah ini termasuk pengkhianatan negara? Apa mereka bakal menjebloskan kita ke sel isolasi?

items.source: ~z~I don't read scripts anyway... I'll tell you what, send me your treatment, I'll get some coverage on it.
items.target: ~z~Lagipula aku jarang baca naskah... begini saja, kirimkan sinopsismu, nanti kubaca ringkasannya.

items.source: ~z~Now, to take down the firewall, run BruteForce.exe.
~z~The wind will tie us in a knot, we gotta keep moving.
items.target: ~z~Angin bakal mengacaukan laju kita, kita harus terus bergerak.

items.source: ~z~So as long as we all are not together,
items.target: ~z~Jadi selama kita semua tidak berkumpul bersama,

items.source: ~z~Concentrate, you gotta find this terminal's IP in the network spew.
items.target: ~z~Fokus, kau harus temukan IP terminal ini di aliran data jaringan.

items.source: ~z~Yeah, we had a plan - hold off the nastiest team of crooked FIB agents in the country
items.target: ~z~Ya, rencana kita tadi - menahan tim agen FIB paling korup dan kejam di seantero negeri

items.source: ~z~Man, let's get the fuck out of here.
items.target: ~z~Kawan, ayo kita cabut dari sini sekarang juga.

items.source: ~z~Aren't they meant to try and arrest us!?
~z~I'm getting the hang of this heist work, Server Room's in the bottom right of my plans here.
items.target: ~z~Aku mulai terbiasa dengan kerjaan perampokan ini, Ruang Server ada di kanan bawah rencanaku ini.

items.source: ~z~I picked you guys out especially for this shit show, so take something from that if you will.
items.target: ~z~Kalian kupilih khusus untuk misi gila ini, jadi anggaplah itu pujian kalau kalian mau.

items.source: ~z~Yeah, cool. We can joke about how screwed up your damn life is.
items.target: ~z~Ya, bagus. Kita bisa menertawakan betapa kacaunya hidupmu yang menyedihkan itu.

items.source: ~z~It's goin' cost you, homie. Trust me, you goin' pay for that shit.
items.target: ~z~Kau bakal menanggung akibatnya, sobat. Percayalah, kau bakal membayarnya mahal.

items.source: ~z~This has happened, now let's get out of it.
items.target: ~z~Ini sudah terjadi, sekarang ayo kita cari jalan keluar.

items.source: ~z~I'm gonna take us up to the jump spot.
items.target: ~z~Aku akan bawa kita naik ke titik terjun.

items.source: ~z~The download ain't done yet, bros. Hang in there.
items.target: ~z~Unduhannya belum selesai, kawan. Bertahanlah di sana.

items.source: ~z~Man, I was just fucking with you, dog. Let's do this shit.
items.target: ~z~Kawan, aku tadi cuma bercanda, sobat. Ayo kita selesaikan urusan ini.

items.source: ~z~M, M, you see that? I smoked him.
items.target: ~z~M, M, kau lihat tadi? Kuantar dia ke liang lahat.

items.source: ~z~I just saved your asses, come on.
items.target: ~z~Aku baru saja menyelamatkan nyawa kalian, ayolah.

items.source: ~z~We can't move with that thing up there!
items.target: ~z~Kita tidak bisa bergerak kalau benda itu masih ada di atas sana!

items.source: ~z~Whoever's thing it is, it's unauthorized and it's dumb.
items.target: ~z~Punya siapa pun itu, itu tidak berizin dan bodoh.

items.source: ~z~You Steve's pilot? Take us to the chopper.
items.target: ~z~Kau pilotnya Steve? Bawa kami ke helikopter.

items.source: ~z~Dude, I would not know where to start, maybe like take a screwdriver to 'em.
items.target: ~z~Bung, aku sama sekali tidak tahu harus mulai dari mana, mungkin coba congkel pakai obeng.

items.source: ~z~If it's you dudes rappelling down the building, I think a Bureau chopper's kind of spotted you.
items.target: ~z~Kalau yang meluncur turun dari gedung itu kalian, sepertinya helikopter Biro melihat kalian.

items.source: ~z~That's a negative on the sprinklers, system's in emergency mode now. I can't break it.
items.target: ~z~Pemercik air tidak bisa dimatikan, sistemnya sekarang dalam mode darurat. Aku tidak bisa membobolnya.

items.source: ~z~Hey! That was real simple, wasn't it? I'm informed now, dog.
items.target: ~z~Hei! Itu gampang banget, kan? Sekarang aku sudah paham, kawan.

items.source: ~z~We've got one shot at this, pickup has to be soon.
items.target: ~z~Kita cuma punya satu kesempatan, penjemputan harus dilakukan segera.

items.source: ~z~I haven't looked forward to killing this much since the academy.
items.target: ~z~Aku sudah lama tidak seantusias ini untuk membunuh orang sejak masa akademi.

items.source: ~z~Of all the ways for a midlife crisis to manifest itself.
items.target: ~z~Dari sekian banyak cara krisis paruh baya melampiaskan diri.

items.source: ~z~I'll grab the files when this heat dies down! Get me an opening!
items.target: ~z~Akan kuambil file-filenya setelah tembak-menembak ini mereda! Beri aku celah!

items.source: ~z~Alright, we're coming up here. The chopper pilot, gunman, driver and hacker should be ready. I'll radio in.
items.target: ~z~Baiklah, kita hampir sampai. Pilot helikopter, penembak, sopir, dan peretas harus sudah siap. Aku akan menghubungi lewat radio.

items.source: ~z~The IP number you n-need is at the top - look for it in the larger grid.
items.target: ~z~Nomor IP yang kau b-butuhkan ada di atas - cari nomor itu di kisi-kisi yang lebih besar.

items.source: ~z~The program will expose each character of the password as it tries different encryptions.
items.target: ~z~Program ini akan membuka setiap karakter kata sandi saat mencoba berbagai enkripsi berbeda.

items.source: ~z~Just back up a god damn minute!
~z~Let's get a few of 'em off of us!
~z~Take a yoga or meditation break if you need one, bro.
items.target: ~z~Istirahatlah untuk yoga atau meditasi kalau kau butuh, kawan.

items.source: ~z~Remember that if I ever hire you again.
items.target: ~z~Ingat itu kalau sampai aku mempekerjakanmu lagi.

items.source: ~z~Agent Steve's set up a base of operations at the Noose building off the Palomino Freeway.
items.target: ~z~Agen Steve menyiapkan pangkalan operasi di gedung NOOSE dekat Palomino Freeway.

items.source: ~z~I guess 'cause I'm not the one who's about to die,
items.target: ~z~Kurasa karena bukan aku yang bakal mati,

items.source: ~z~We're getting outta here, one way or another!
items.target: ~z~Kita bakal keluar dari sini, apa pun caranya!

items.source: ~z~Yeah, it worked. I'm glad we stuck with you, kid.
items.target: ~z~Ya, berhasil. Aku senang kita tetap mempercayaimu, bocah.

items.source: ~z~They're on top of us! Left side of the roof!
items.target: ~z~Mereka tepat di atas kita! Sisi kiri atap!

items.source: ~z~You're a good man and a great father, really.
items.target: ~z~Kau pria yang baik dan ayah yang hebat, sungguh.

items.source: ~z~Now let's get some linkage - gimme Hack Connect in this bitch.
items.target: ~z~Sekarang ayo kita sambungkan - buka Hack Connect di komputer ini.

items.source: ~z~Oh, right, you mean like with your deal. Um, maybe they called the military or something?
items.target: ~z~Oh, betul, maksudmu kesepakatan itu. Um, mungkin mereka memanggil militer atau semacamnya?

items.source: ~z~There's a bunch of n-network spew, but you should be able to locate this terminal by its IP.
items.target: ~z~Ada banyak a-aliran data jaringan, tapi kau pasti bisa melacak terminal ini lewat IP-nya.

items.source: ~z~there's nothing they can really do to us.
items.target: ~z~tidak ada yang benar-benar bisa mereka lakukan pada kita.

items.source: ~z~We made it outta there! They can't catch us now!
items.target: ~z~Kita berhasil keluar dari sana! Mereka tidak bisa menangkap kita sekarang!

items.source: ~z~Hey, uhhh, I thought this was a low risk type deal.
items.target: ~z~Hei, uhhh, kupikir ini urusan berisiko rendah.

items.source: ~z~I brought the van - you're driving it!
~z~I took this job, I knew it was going to be like that.
items.target: ~z~Kuterima pekerjaan ini, aku tahu resikonya bakal seperti ini.

items.source: ~z~This little puppy's gonna locate your IP address in the network output.
items.target: ~z~Program kecil ini bakal menemukan alamat IP kalian di keluaran jaringan.

items.source: ~z~Hey, you want to side with Trevor? Feel free.
items.target: ~z~Hei, kau mau berpihak pada Trevor? Silakan saja.

items.source: ~z~Eh, it's too risky! We gotta deal with these guys before you can move for the files!
items.target: ~z~Terlalu berisiko! Kita harus habisi orang-orang ini sebelum kau bisa ambil file-filenya!

items.source: ~z~ I just need to get my shit together.
items.target: ~z~ Aku cuma perlu bereskan masalah pribadiku.

items.source: ~z~Then you are ready to bring down a firewall. Brute Force, bitches. Boot it up.
items.target: ~z~Lalu kalian siap menjebol firewall. Brute Force, bajingan. Jalankan aplikasinya.

items.source: ~z~Don't get snarky, bro. You saw my machizzle at Lifeinvader, you knew what you were getting into.
items.target: ~z~Jangan sewot, kawan. Kau sudah lihat keahlianku di Lifeinvader, kau tahu apa risikonya.

items.source: ~z~I'd say that you've got off pretty lightly,
items.target: ~z~Bisa kubilang kau lolos dengan cukup mudah,

items.source: ~z~I have to admit. I've been remiss. Everyone's being paid on this run, except me.
items.target: ~z~Harus kuakui. Aku lalai. Semua orang dibayar dalam operasi ini, kecuali aku.

items.source: ~z~It's underway. We'll need that chopper ASAP, get her over the building!
items.target: ~z~Sudah dimulai. Kita butuh helikopter itu secepatnya, bawa ke atas gedung!

items.source: ~z~Eh, there's Steve Haines' chopper - crashed out in the fountain.
items.target: ~z~Lihat, itu helikopter Steve Haines - jatuh hancur di kolam air mancur.

items.source: ~z~I haven't got a script... but I'm working on a treatment.
items.target: ~z~Aku belum punya naskah lengkap... tapi sedang mengerjakan sinopsis ceritanya.

items.source: ~z~The password might reset if you lock the wrong letter, dude.
items.target: ~z~Kata sandinya mungkin tereset kalau kau mengunci huruf yang salah, bung.

items.source: ~z~Fix the rope there, and we can get down to the street.
items.target: ~z~Kaitkan talinya di sana, dan kita bisa turun ke jalan.

items.source: ~z~Other guys, they got work on the side... I'm sure you've got some lucrative investments, you know...
items.target: ~z~Orang lain punya pekerjaan sampingan... Aku yakin Anda punya investasi menguntungkan di luar sana...

items.source: ~z~I'm out, Davey. From now on. Done.
~z~I've been blueskying and, like, process of elimination, you've only got one app left.
items.target: ~z~Kupikir-pikir lagi dan lewat eliminasi, aplikasimu tinggal tersisa satu.

items.source: ~z~This is just like improv class... except we get killed if we bomb.

items.source: ~z~After I take care of this shit...

items.target: ~z~Ke mana perginya janji mengubur masa lalu, hah?

items.source: ~z~Let alone calculate the odds of surviving the jump,
items.target: ~z~Apalagi menghitung peluang selamat dari terjun payung,

items.source: ~z~Guys on the rooftop, in the middle, dog!

items.source: ~z~We get caught, my wife will kill me before we go to trial.

items.source: ~z~Okay. Okay. I can see. Maybe I've been a little caught up in myself lately.
items.target: ~z~Oke. Oke. Aku sadar. Mungkin akhir-akhir ini aku terlalu memikirkan diriku sendiri.

items.source: ~z~Okay, we lost 'em, Frank. We're meeting Lester at your place for a debrief.
items.target: ~z~Oke, kita berhasil lolos dari mereka, Frank. Kita bertemu Lester di rumahmu untuk evaluasi.

items.source: ~z~Poor Michael, whose homies get into shit with the FIB out of the kindness of they own heart.

items.source: ~z~What you think, boss? I say start shooting!
items.target: ~z~Bagaimana menurutmu, bos? Menurutku mulai tembak saja!

items.source: ~z~Right ahead, on the roof, look out!

items.source: ~z~if you're ever late for a pick up again, I'm gonna leave your ass for the cops, okay? I hope you get that.

items.source: ~z~Why you think Lester burned down the business? Hell, why do you think I'm doing it for nothing,

items.source: ~z~Uhhh, yeah. Lester had the plan. It was all set up.
items.target: ~z~Uhhh, ya. Lester yang punya rencana. Semuanya sudah diatur.

items.source: ~z~And tell us if anything bad comes over the airwaves.
items.target: ~z~Dan beri tahu kami kalau ada kabar buruk lewat siaran radio.

items.source: ~z~But it ain't great money for the crazy target you're drawing on your backs,
items.target: ~z~Tapi uangnya tidak sebanding dengan bahaya gila yang mengintai kalian,

items.source: ~z~You're lucky I brought anything on my salary. Let's just get ready for the security team.

items.source: ~z~Awkward, bros. A Bureau chopper's seen you on the side of the building.
items.target: ~z~Gawat, kawan. Helikopter Biro melihat kalian di sisi gedung.

items.source: ~z~I'll take that from M, not from you, punk. Let's get ready for security.
items.target: ~z~Biar M saja yang bicara begitu padaku, bukan kau, anak ingusan. Mari bersiap hadapi petugas keamanan.

items.source: ~z~Come on. Come on. That's a good boy. Come back to me. Come on. Come on. You're not going anywhere buddy. Come on.
items.target: ~z~Ayo. Ayo. Anak pintar. Sadarlah. Ayo. Ayo. Kau tidak akan ke mana-mana, kawan. Ayo.

items.source: ~z~They don't make cops smart - none I've met, at least.
items.target: ~z~Polisi itu tidak ada yang pintar - setidaknya yang pernah kutemui.

items.source: ~z~So, like, yeah, you're trying to stop those red letters in the middle.
items.target: ~z~Jadi, ya, kau harus menghentikan huruf-huruf merah di tengah itu.

items.source: ~z~Good for you, bro. I'm out here.
items.target: ~z~Baguslah buatmu, kawan. Aku menunggu di luar sini.

items.source: ~z~The government don't like people stealing data.
items.target: ~z~Pemerintah tidak suka orang mencuri data mereka.

items.source: ~z~Stop my lady scoping le browser histoire.
~z~Oh shit. It's the ambulance! Get in!
~z~Alright. Here's the shot. We're taking a chopper up to altitude.
items.target: ~z~Baiklah. Begini rencananya. Kita naik helikopter sampai ketinggian tertentu.

items.source: ~z~Come on, so they can't see us get in!
items.target: ~z~Ayo cepat, biar mereka tidak lihat kita masuk!

items.source: ~z~So, in short. Thank you for your efforts. It means a lot to me.
items.target: ~z~Singkatnya, terima kasih atas kerja keras kalian. Ini sangat berarti bagiku.

items.source: ~z~Common or not, it takes balls, and you got 'em.
items.target: ~z~Biasa atau tidak, itu butuh keberanian besar, dan kau memilikinya.

items.source: ~z~We might be getting away with this...
items.target: ~z~Kita mungkin bisa lolos dari semua ini...

items.source: ~z~They catch us, we ain't going to no normal jailhouse, dog!
items.target: ~z~Kalau mereka menangkap kita, kita tidak bakal masuk penjara biasa, kawan!

items.source: ~z~Haines' guy? You gonna take us to your chopper?
items.target: ~z~Orangnya Haines? Kau bakal antar kami ke helikoptermu?

items.source: ~z~you're a good man and a great father, really.
items.target: ~z~kau pria yang baik dan ayah yang hebat, sungguh.

items.source: ~z~What are you looking so cool, calm, and collected for?
items.target: ~z~Kenapa kau terlihat begitu santai, tenang, dan tanpa beban?

items.source: ~z~Okay, I'm less inclined to stab you in the face and then do funny things to your corpse.
items.target: ~z~Oke, niatku menusuk mukamu lalu memperlakukan mayatmu aneh-aneh agak berkurang sekarang.

items.source: ~z~They're on top of us! Dead center!
items.target: ~z~Mereka tepat di atas kita! Tepat di tengah!

items.source: ~z~Your cellular will show as an external device, okay?
items.target: ~z~Ponselmu bakal muncul sebagai perangkat eksternal, paham?

items.source: ~z~It ain't safe yet! We take care of these guys, then you move for the files!
items.target: ~z~Belum aman! Kita habisi orang-orang ini dulu, baru kau ambil file-filenya!

items.source: ~z~I might have to go back to school again. So I can drop out again.
items.target: ~z~Mungkin aku harus masuk sekolah lagi. Supaya aku bisa drop out lagi.

items.source: ~z~I don't know what to tell you, bro. I think everything you need's on your cell.
items.target: ~z~Aku tidak tahu harus bilang apa, kawan. Kupikir semua yang kau butuhkan ada di ponselmu.
~z~Ssst. Mari kita beri kejutan untuk orang-orang ini.

items.source: ~z~Agent Stevie cleared the NOOSE building in Palomino Highlands as a base for this op.
items.target: ~z~Agen Stevie mengamankan gedung NOOSE di Palomino Highlands sebagai pangkalan untuk operasi ini.

items.source: ~z~It wasn't my intention to begrudge you anything, pal. That said -
items.target: ~z~Aku tidak bermaksud iri atau perhitungan padamu, sobat. Meski begitu -

items.source: ~z~They're gonna pick us up if we hold here.
items.target: ~z~Mereka bakal mengepung kita kalau kita bertahan di sini.

items.source: ~z~Find that number, dude. That's all I can say.
items.target: ~z~Temukan angka itu, bung. Cuma itu yang bisa kukatakan.

items.source: ~z~The Server Room is in the South East corner of the building.
items.target: ~z~Ruang Server ada di sudut Tenggara gedung.

items.source: ~z~I guess it's too late to pull out.
~z~they probably goin' pop him anyway to clean up loose ends.
items.target: ~z~mereka kemungkinan tetap bakal menghabisinya untuk menghilangkan jejak.

items.source: ~z~Typical, they get us outside the building.
items.target: ~z~Sudah kuduga, mereka mencegat kita di luar gedung.

items.source: ~z~Agents on the roof! Look down the middle!
items.target: ~z~Agen di atap! Lihat ke bagian tengah!

items.source: ~z~Franklin, the debrief's happening at your place.
~z~You're screwing with me, right? I've already given you a major discount on my standard rate.
items.target: ~z~Kau mempermainkanku, kan? Aku sudah memberimu potongan harga besar dari tarif standarku.

items.source: ~z~Looking at the plans, I think the Server Room's in the South East corner.
items.target: ~z~Melihat denah ini, kurasa Ruang Server ada di sudut Tenggara.

items.source: ~z~Any fool should be able to turn over a new leaf, right?
items.target: ~z~Orang bodoh mana pun seharusnya bisa membuka lembaran baru, kan?

items.source: ~z~Karim, Frank's place is up here. You think you can dispose of the vehicle, and drop him somewhere?
items.target: ~z~Karim, rumah Frank ada di depan sini. Bisakah kau buang kendaraannya, dan turunkan dia di suatu tempat?
~z~Dia bakal tembak punggung kita dua kali.

items.source: ~z~A little? Man, just gimme the plan, okay?
~z~Come on. Come on. Don't die on me here. Come on, buddy.
items.target: ~z~Ayo. Ayo. Jangan mati dulu di depanku. Ayo, kawan.

items.source: ~z~There's a lot of fucking numbers, bro.
~z~So the plan was feeling sorry for your ass, right? I missed Lester saying that shit, but sure, let's feel sorry for Michael.
items.target: ~z~Jadi rencananya adalah mengasihanimu, kan? Sepertinya aku melewatkan omongan Lester soal itu, tapi baiklah, mari kita kasihani Michael.
~z~Hei, F, kau yang memimpin di depan.

items.source: ~z~Set up the gear there, and we'll drop to the street.
items.target: ~z~Pasang peralatannya di sana, lalu kita turun ke jalan.

items.source: ~z~Shit, yeah, of course. Don't think I'm ungrateful...
items.target: ~z~Sial, ya, tentu saja. Jangan kira aku tidak berterima kasih...

items.source: ~z~Any longer and I was going to torch this place too.
items.target: ~z~Sedikit lebih lama lagi dan aku juga bakal membakar tempat ini.

items.source: ~z~Is this guy in charge of the operation?
~z~Yeah, sure, man. We had it covered.
items.target: ~z~Ya, tentu saja, kawan. Tadi kami sudah mengatasinya.

items.source: ~z~but give me a break. You and Lester. Shit.
items.target: ~z~tapi jangan berlebihan. Kau dan Lester. Sialan.

items.source: ~z~Boy, I'm still shaking. I'm still so fucking tense.
items.target: ~z~Bung, aku masih gemetaran. Aku masih tegang setengah mati.

items.source: ~z~So you wanna wallow in some more of your self pity? Get another free therapy session?
items.target: ~z~Jadi kau mau terus meratapi nasibmu? Mau sesi terapi gratis lagi?

items.source: ~z~They got the drop on us! Check the roof! Right in front!
items.target: ~z~Mereka menyergap kita! Periksa atap! Tepat di depan!

items.source: ~z~We're robbing government secrets out of a government building in a government chopper. Great.
items.target: ~z~Kita mencuri rahasia pemerintah dari gedung pemerintah menggunakan helikopter pemerintah. Luar biasa.

items.source: ~z~A couple more scores, they're taken care of, and I can think about getting out the game.
items.target: ~z~Beberapa mangsa lagi, mereka beres, dan aku bisa mulai berpikir untuk pensiun dari dunia hitam.

items.source: ~z~We're taking fire from the left side of the roof!
items.target: ~z~Kita dihujani tembakan dari sisi kiri atap!

items.source: ~z~I appreciate that. I'm trying my best for you, but...
items.target: ~z~Kuhargai itu. Aku sudah berusaha sebaik mungkin untukmu, tapi...
~z~bajingan tua yang membenci dirinya sendiri, kawan, tapi...

items.source: ~z~You total asshole! Now we gotta lose the cops!
items.target: ~z~Kau benar-benar bajingan! Sekarang kita harus kabur dari polisi!

items.source: ~z~This is awkward, I didn't think I'd see you again.
items.target: ~z~Canggung sekali, kupikir aku tidak bakal bertemu denganmu lagi.

items.source: ~z~Are we going to get away from them?
items.target: ~z~Apakah kita bakal bisa lolos dari mereka?

items.source: ~z~I don't know if you have the firepower to hold them off. ETA is any minute.
items.target: ~z~Aku tidak tahu apakah persenjataan kalian cukup untuk menahan mereka. Waktu tiba mereka tinggal hitungan menit.

items.source: ~z~No need to be aggressive, bro. I'm stretching myself.
items.target: ~z~Tidak usah ngegas, kawan. Aku sedang berusaha semampuku.

items.source: ~z~Eh, here you go, dog, that's a nice weapon.
~z~Down and Out's got a kinda like final ring to it.
items.target: ~z~Down and Out kedengarannya seperti akhir dari segalanya.

items.source: ~z~I should never have signed up with you!
~z~We're gonna get outta this, right M?
items.target: ~z~Kita bakal lolos dari ini kan, M?

items.source: ~z~We're clear. Let's get of this thing!
items.target: ~z~Kita aman. Ayo turun dari benda ini!

items.source: ~z~Eyes up! Left side of the rooflight!
items.target: ~z~Awas di atas! Sisi kiri jendela atap!

items.source: ~z~Looking at this, maybe you should, like, run the hackconnect first?
items.target: ~z~Melihat ini, mungkin sebaiknya kau jalankan hackconnect dulu?

items.source: ~z~Act like a paramedic crew. If one of you unloads his weapon, I'll cut his other weapon off.
items.target: ~z~Bersikaplah seperti kru paramedis. Kalau salah satu dari kalian menembakkan senjatanya, bakal kupotong 'senjata' kalian yang satunya.

items.source: ~z~That's a good point. I ain't gonna have the time to spend it, so enjoy.
items.target: ~z~Poin bagus. Aku juga tidak bakal sempat menghabiskannya, jadi nikmatilah.

items.source: ~z~I think I'd better stay at least a little bit sober.
items.target: ~z~Kurasa sebaiknya aku tetap sadar setidaknya sedikit.

items.source: ~z~Let's go. Come on now, you're not going anywhere.
items.target: ~z~Ayo. Ayolah, kau tidak akan ke mana-mana.

items.source: ~z~I got it. Prints, DNA, whole thing will be clean.
items.target: ~z~Beres. Sidik jari, DNA, semuanya bakal bersih tak berbekas.

items.source: ~z~and there's a good chance this thing won't work at all.
items.target: ~z~dan besar kemungkinan benda ini tidak bakal berfungsi sama sekali.

items.source: ~z~I got a lifestyle to maintain - cars, holidays, my watch collection, hormones.
items.target: ~z~Ada gaya hidup yang harus kujaga - mobil, liburan, koleksi jam tangan, suplemen hormon.

items.source: ~z~Ah, no shit. I'm a producer. You should send me your script.
items.target: ~z~Ah, serius. Aku seorang produser. Kau harus kirimkan naskahmu padaku.

items.source: ~z~Rich, white Michael. Poor Michael, who robbed banks for ten years then got his slate wiped clean.
items.target: ~z~Michael si kaya berkulit putih. Kasihan sekali Michael, yang merampok bank sepuluh tahun lalu dosanya dihapus bersih.

items.source: ~z~This straight talking, new, 'tell it like it is' reality guy act?
items.target: ~z~Gaya bicara blak-blakan, baru, dan sok apa adanya ini?

items.source: ~z~I'm taking us up to jump altitude.
items.target: ~z~Aku bawa kita naik ke ketinggian terjun.

items.source: ~z~I'm in the system - okay, shutting down fire suppression.
items.target: ~z~Aku sudah masuk sistem - oke, mematikan pemadam kebakaran.

items.source: ~z~Now I got to hack your cock off, man. You wish.
items.target: ~z~Sekarang aku harus memotong 'burung'mu, kawan. Jangan ngarep.

items.source: ~z~Select them quickly, 'cause they won't be active for long.
items.target: ~z~Pilih dengan cepat, karena itu tidak akan aktif lama.

items.source: ~z~Shit, they're wise to us! Let's go!
items.target: ~z~Sial, mereka tahu penyamaran kita! Ayo cabut!

items.source: ~z~Everything you do and don't do is recorded forever and used to beat you.
items.target: ~z~Segala hal yang kau lakukan dan tidak kau lakukan dicatat selamanya dan dipakai untuk menjatuhkanmu.

items.source: ~z~I was contracted to do a job and I did it... well.
items.target: ~z~Aku dikontrak untuk sebuah pekerjaan dan sudah kuselesaikan... dengan baik.

items.source: ~z~Alright, I'm connected. No thanks to you.
items.target: ~z~Baiklah, aku sudah tersambung. Sama sekali bukan berkat bantuanmu.

items.source: ~z~You know what, Mike? You a real easy dude to identify with, man. Poor me. Poor me.
items.target: ~z~Kau tahu apa, Mike? Kau ini orang yang gampang ditebak, kawan. Kasihan aku. Kasihan aku.
~z~Apa yang sedang terjadi di sebelah sana?

items.source: ~z~Be cool... follow my lead... I've done some improv classes.
items.target: ~z~Tenang... ikuti petunjukku... aku pernah ikut kelas improvisasi.

items.source: ~z~I'll hold here, wait on your signal for pickup.
items.target: ~z~Aku bertahan di sini, menunggu sinyalmu untuk penjemputan.

items.source: ~z~A'ight. Now let's roll on this thing.
items.target: ~z~Bagus. Sekarang ayo kita mulai rencana ini.

items.source: ~z~you're going to wake up one morning with a gun in your mouth.
items.target: ~z~suatu pagi kau bakal terbangun dengan moncong pistol di dalam mulutmu.

items.source: ~z~You've gone and done it! After everything I did to make this easy!
items.target: ~z~Kau malah merusaknya! Padahal aku sudah bersusah payah mempermudah segalanya!

items.source: ~z~You know what they'll do to the dudes who took down the Bureau? It ain't goin' be nice.
items.target: ~z~Kau tahu apa yang bakal mereka lakukan pada orang yang membobol Biro? Pasti tidak bakal menyenangkan.

items.source: ~z~Maybe if he was getting a bigger cut, dog, he'd have the right equipment.
items.target: ~z~Mungkin kalau bagiannya lebih besar, kawan, perlengkapannya bakal lebih beres.

items.source: ~z~Yeah, screwing up once is understandable. Twice? Unacceptable.
items.target: ~z~Ya, mengacau sekali masih bisa dimaklumi. Dua kali? Tidak bisa diterima.

items.source: ~z~Ground units, air units, every unit in the state is on the way.
items.target: ~z~Unit darat, unit udara, setiap aparat di negara bagian ini sedang menuju ke sini.

items.source: ~z~Well, first, your new leaves aren't so very different from your previous leaves.
items.target: ~z~Pertama, lembaran barumu tidak jauh berbeda dari lembaran lamamu.

items.source: ~z~Keep climbing, you'll only make it to the rooftop DZ if you have the altitude.
items.target: ~z~Terus naik, kalian cuma bisa sampai ke zona pendaratan atap kalau punya cukup ketinggian.

items.source: ~z~They on top of us! On the left there!
items.target: ~z~Mereka menyergap kita! Di sebelah kiri sana!

items.source: ~z~Alright, you're Haines' pilot, right? We got to wait until it's late enough, then we move in the chopper.
items.target: ~z~Baiklah, kau pilotnya Haines, kan? Kita harus tunggu sampai cukup larut, baru kita berangkat naik helikopter.

items.source: ~z~and Dave will look after me... I think.
~z~Driver should be meeting us out front!
~z~When I got told I was the backup escape plan, I didn't think it was gonna get this heavy!
items.target: ~z~Waktu diberitahu kalau aku jadi rencana pelarian cadangan, aku tidak menyangka situasinya bakal segawat ini!

items.source: ~z~This place gives me the creeps, homes. Same with this Fed pilot.
items.target: ~z~Tempat ini membuatku merinding, kawan. Sama halnya dengan pilot Federal ini.

items.source: ~z~What is this? Pick on me day? Look, I know I am a miserable old prick,
items.target: ~z~Ada apa ini? Hari mencemooh diriku? Dengar, aku tahu aku orang tua brengsek yang menyedihkan,
~z~Aku panik setengah mati, kita harus pergi!

items.source: ~z~We took down the Bureau - these cops can't touch us!
items.target: ~z~Kita sudah membobol Biro - polisi-polisi ini tidak bakal bisa menyentuh kita!

items.source: ~z~Drive, man. We'll get out of this.
items.target: ~z~Nyetir, kawan. Kita pasti bisa lolos dari sini.

items.source: ~z~That ain't working so well for me.
~z~Room sealed. Hold while I gain access.
items.target: ~z~Ruangan tersegel. Bertahanlah selagi aku membobol akses.

items.source: ~z~Idiota - I told you what I was going to do, you sick fuck.
items.target: ~z~Idiota - sudah kubilang apa yang bakal kulakukan, dasar bajingan sakit jiwa.

items.source: ~z~Honest and angry. This is some of the best mental health work I've done in years.
items.target: ~z~Jujur dan penuh amarah. Ini terapi kesehatan mental terbaik yang pernah kulakukan selama bertahun-tahun.

items.source: ~z~Man, that could be the job or it could be you thinkin' bout all the dudes who wanna clap your ass.
items.target: ~z~Kawan, itu bisa jadi karena pekerjaan ini atau karena kau memikirkan semua orang yang ingin membunuhmu.

items.source: ~z~We hit the computer system, that might take a while, so we gotta hold off any resistance.
items.target: ~z~Kita membobol sistem komputernya, itu mungkin butuh waktu, jadi kita harus menahan perlawanan apa pun.

items.source: ~z~M can handle this! I know it!

items.target: ~z~Beberapa lantai hancur lebur, kawan. Luluh lantak.

items.source: ~z~We got to hold 'em off till the driver makes it!
items.target: ~z~Kita harus menahan mereka sampai sopirnya sampai!

items.source: ~z~Seems like they all fell from a pretty similar tree, and second,
items.target: ~z~Kelihatannya mereka semua berasal dari jenis yang sama, dan kedua,

items.source: ~z~...then y-you need to lock it manually.
~z~Right, right. Uhh... cellphone. Connect it. Programs are on there.
items.target: ~z~Benar, benar. Uhh... ponsel. Hubungkan ponselnya. Programnya ada di situ.

items.source: ~z~This is the age of judgment day, every day.

items.target: ~z~Kerjaan yang sama seperti biasa, kawan. Mencari nafkah.
~z~Jadi, tulisan macam apa yang kau buat?

items.source: ~z~Don't worry. We got a backup plan. Use the harnesses. Rappel from a few floors down.
items.target: ~z~Jangan khawatir. Kita punya rencana cadangan. Pakai tali pengaman. Meluncur turun dari beberapa lantai di bawah.

items.source: ~z~They can't put us all on death row... can they?
items.target: ~z~Mereka tidak bisa menghukum mati kita semua... kan?

items.source: ~z~The download isn't finished. Keep holding them off while the process completes.
items.target: ~z~Unduhannya belum selesai. Terus tahan mereka selagi prosesnya selesai.
~z~Jangan mati konyol gara-gara urusan ini, kawan!

items.source: ~z~These cops don't realise MT is running the crew!
items.target: ~z~Polisi-polisi ini tidak sadar kalau MT yang memimpin krunya!

items.source: ~z~We hit the Bureau for you, Dave. I'm done.
items.target: ~z~Kami sudah serbu Biro untukmu, Dave. Aku selesai.

items.source: ~z~Good work, start Down&Out.exe and I'll do the rest from here.
items.target: ~z~Kerja bagus, jalankan Down&Out.exe dan biar kuselesaikan sisanya dari sini.

items.source: ~z~The heli c-crash might cause you t-trouble. L-looks like a lot of damage. Explosion went through a couple of floors.
items.target: ~z~T-tabrakan heli itu mungkin bikin kalian k-kesulitan. K-kelihatannya kerusakannya parah. Ledakannya menembus beberapa lantai.

items.source: ~z~let's get the hell out of here.
~z~I probably should have said I don't code any more, I just design and manage.
items.target: ~z~Mungkin seharusnya kubilang dari awal kalau aku sudah tidak coding lagi, cuma mendesain dan mengelola.

items.source: ~z~Keep going up, you'll need height if you're going to land clean on the HQ DZ.
items.target: ~z~Terus naik, kalian butuh ketinggian kalau mau mendarat mulus di zona pendaratan markas besar.

items.source: ~z~After this, I'm getting one just like yours, man. Seriously.
items.target: ~z~Setelah ini, aku bakal beli yang persis punyamu, kawan. Serius.

items.source: ~z~I can't take much more of this!
items.target: ~z~Aku sudah tidak tahan lagi dengan semua ini!

items.source: ~z~It don't look like they're for us, not yet at least!
items.target: ~z~Kelihatannya mereka bukan mengincar kita, setidaknya belum!

items.source: ~z~No one told me what to get. A good manager woulda been specific.
items.target: ~z~Tidak ada yang memberitahuku harus bawa apa. Bos yang baik pasti memberi arahan spesifik.

items.source: ~z~You won't make the DZ from here.
items.target: ~z~Kau tidak akan sampai ke zona terjun dari sini.

items.source: ~z~Makes me think he don't got faith in his own crazy plan.
items.target: ~z~Membuatku berpikir dia sendiri tidak yakin dengan rencana gilanya.

items.source: ~z~Karim, come in. Hey, you're not at the pickup spot.
items.target: ~z~Karim, masuk. Hei, kau tidak ada di titik penjemputan.

items.source: ~z~Change of plan. Use the backup gear. Make our way down the building. Rappel off the side.
items.target: ~z~Perubahan rencana. Gunakan perlengkapan cadangan. Turun menyusuri gedung. Meluncur turun di sisi gedung.

items.source: ~z~If you want to pilot the first leg, I'll take over once you jump.
items.target: ~z~Kalau kau mau menerbangkan leg pertama, biar kuambil alih setelah kalian terjun.

items.source: ~z~I thought long and hard what to bring along this time.
items.target: ~z~Kupikirkan masak-masak apa yang harus kubawa kali ini.

items.source: ~z~Now, start Down and Out, and lemme go to work.
items.target: ~z~Sekarang, buka Down and Out, dan biarkan aku bekerja.

items.source: ~z~There should be a phone icon. Open it.
items.target: ~z~Seharusnya ada ikon ponsel. Buka ikon itu.

items.source: ~z~I gotta deal with Davey and Dickwad yet, put things to bed.
items.target: ~z~Aku masih harus berurusan dengan Davey dan si brengsek itu, selesaikan semuanya.

items.source: ~z~There's no one else I'd rather rob a Federal building with.
items.target: ~z~Tidak ada orang lain yang lebih kupercaya untuk merampok gedung Federal selain kalian.
